strategy: Hard-enforce clean governed roots and ratchet existing build/lib debt downward; never require a big-bang move solely to satisfy a numeric ceiling.

forbiddenImports.reason: Core contracts and authority may not depend on UI, runtime gateway implementations or product feature implementations.
Product modules may expose UI to app composition, but module implementation may not depend back on the Next.js app shell.

compatibilityBridgeExceptions.removalCondition: Retarget the two remaining route consumers to @/modules/build/pageflow, then delete this bridge.
